description: Layered runtime fan-out for asset compute. Declare N processing layers at plan-compile time; the number of work items at each layer is 100% discovered at runtime. Each layer's fan-out renders as real graph nodes via DynamicOutput. Between layers we auto-scaffold a collect+re-emit bridge so any depth is legal (Dagster rejects two dynamic outputs feeding one op — the bridge sidesteps that). Companion @task decorator + @task_asset decorator ship in the same package for imperative-style shapes.

outputs.description: One graph asset. Each declared layer becomes a fan-out graph node (`<asset>.<layer>_process[?]`) — instances discovered at runtime.

layers.label: Layers
layers.description: Ordered list of processing layers. First layer's compute receives (context) and emits initial (name, spec) pairs. Later layers receive (context, spec) per item.

name.description: Layer name; used as graph-node prefix.

terminal.label: Terminal Reducer
terminal.description: Optional 'mod:fn' receiving (context, all_results: list). Returns the asset's final value.

name: Task Asset
